stem:
Aamir lists rose, mango tree, cow, crow, and fish from the school garden and pond.

Does this set represent biodiversity of living things around the school?

options.text: No, because biodiversity means only wild animals in a forest.
Yes: several kinds of plants and animals are present in this place.
Yes only if every name starts with a different letter.
No, because a garden is not a habitat.

teacher.key_rationale: Biodiversity here is variety of living things in a place. A school garden and pond count. Letter of the name does not.
